subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-off Feishu `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` config contract for proactive per-target outbound pacing, and what proof bar is required before merge?
rationale: Source inspection supports the missing capability, but the PR adds a new operator-facing config key and currently lacks real Feishu behavior proof, so maintainer intent is needed before merging.

options.title: Require Live Feishu Proof First
options.body: Ask for redacted live Feishu terminal/log/artifact proof showing same-target pacing and distinct-target independence, then re-review after the branch is mergeable.

options.title: Accept Mocked-Seam Proof
options.body: Maintainers may explicitly accept source review, fake-timer seam tests, and CI as sufficient, but that owns the live timing proof gap for a new operator setting.

options.title: Reject Or Defer Config Surface
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep the canonical issue open if maintainers do not want this Feishu-specific config contract now.

recommendation.title: Require Live Feishu Proof First
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live Feishu terminal/log/artifact proof showing same-target pacing and distinct-target independence, then re-review after the branch is mergeable.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin owner candidate for Feishu-owned send behavior.
